title: repeated extra help
rule: When the same error repeats (three or more times in one attempt), provide extra help: review error patterns, refine the design, and make messages more actionable.

citation.source: NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§10)

pass_when: On the third-or-more same error in one attempt, the UI offers extra help and more actionable copy than the first showing.
fail_when: The same error copy repeats three or more times with no added help.
overview: The same error repeating three or more times in one attempt gets extra help.
apply_when: Users hit the same validation failure repeatedly in one submit attempt.
not_when: The first showing of an error that has not yet repeated.
agent_hint: On the third same error, add actionable help beyond the first message.
description: When the same error repeats three or more times in one attempt, provide extra help beyond the first showing: review error patterns, refine the design, and make messages more actionable. Apply after users hit the same validation failure repeatedly in one try. Fail the same error copy repeating three or more times with no added help.
